protocol.objective: Preserve the exact four-qubit twelve-angle ring classifier while reducing measured local training time.

fixed.model: Existing TopologyClassifier(topology=ring), unchanged circuit and parameter order
fixed.readout: Original basis integer modulo 3, labels alfalfa/maize/wheat
fixed.preprocessing: Original StandardScaler -> full-SVD PCA4 -> StandardScaler, fit inside each CV training fold
fixed.loss: Original mean base-two cross-entropy; probability floor 1e-10 and matching derivative clipping
fixed.optimizer: Inherited L-BFGS-B fit unchanged, cap 100 loss/gradient calls, maxiter/maxfun=100, ftol=1e-9, gtol=1e-5, maxls=20, no bounds

methods_explained.parameter_shift: Existing native Qiskit Statevector/Operator cached-input per-field evaluator; 25 complete probability passes per loss/gradient call
methods_explained.batched_shift: Same parameter-shift formula and actual bound Qiskit ansatz Operator; NumPy evolves all independent input states as a batch
methods_explained.operator_adjoint: Qiskit-generated full-register RY/CX operator bases, exact matrix-product reverse differentiation of the SAME loss; independent NumPy implementation, not an official Qiskit primitive

selection.data: Only the 914 training fields; prior fixed three stratified folds (seed 2026), not spatial
selection.quality_gate: A faster method must reproduce ALL pooled OOF predicted labels of the unchanged baseline for every seed, and mean final training loss within 1e-7 bits; otherwise retain baseline
selection.cost: Lowest median across seeds of the sum of model construction + fold preprocessing + fit + standard inference over all three folds
selection.ties: Exact timing ties prefer the simpler batched-shift method
selection.ordering: Rotate method execution order across fold/seed pairs to reduce fixed-order bias
selection.no_setting_tuning: No additional optimizer/tolerance/budget grid; the change is derivative/evaluation method only

final_comparison.models: Baseline and training-selected method only, all 914 fields, seeds 0/1/2
final_comparison.validation: One locked comparison on the existing 150 fields; no validation-driven method/setting/seed reselection
final_comparison.inference: Unchanged standard SamplerQNN/QMLSampler(shots=None), even for the faster trainer

timing.include: Model construction, scaler/PCA fit+transform, Qiskit input-state creation, dense-batch conversion, constant-gate cache creation, every optimizer evaluation, inference
timing.profile: Separate cProfile diagnostic timings; do not compare profiled fit time with unprofiled speed results
timing.microbenchmark: Repeated fixed-weight training-only loss/gradient timings, with cache construction recorded separately
timing.accounting: Adjoint forward passes and reverse small-matrix work reported separately; no claim that they equal hardware circuit counts
timing.scope: Exact classical simulation at four qubits, not hardware or quantum-advantage speedup

protocol.environment: Use current Python 3.12 environment; no qiskit-algorithms installation or package upgrades
protocol.preservation: Preserve current on-disk modified demonstration and organizer notebooks, every existing experiment/result/model; create no new notebook
